requestFailed: The BatteryBridge service could not complete this request.
retry: Check the service status and device capabilities, then try again.
readOnlyBody: Battery status and compatibility reports are available. Start the BatteryBridge service to change charging settings.
experimentalNotice: Experimental charge control. Compatibility with this device’s firmware has not been verified.
firstBattery: Applies to the first battery. Other packs keep their own settings.
reportPrivacy: Reports exclude serial numbers and network identifiers. Review the contents before sharing.
footer: Charging features depend on your device and firmware.
reasonSmc: SMC charging control: the service maintains a start/stop band while the Mac is awake. Firmware may refuse changes.
reasonSmcTopUp: The service temporarily allows charging until the battery is full.
reasonSmcDischarge: SMC CH0I: the service restores the adapter at the target percentage.
reasonKernelEnd: Kernel stop threshold. Device write permission is required.
reasonKernelTopUp: Temporary 100% threshold, restored by the service.
reasonGeneric: Not exposed by the generic threshold backend.
reasonLenovo: Lenovo WMI conservation mode, fixed at 80%. Write compatibility has not been verified for this device.
installerWelcome: Installs BatteryBridge in Applications and its background charging service. macOS will request an administrator password. Requires an Intel or Apple Silicon Mac and macOS 11 or newer. Charging features depend on the hardware.
installerUpdate: Updating closes BatteryBridge and restarts the service. Saved settings are kept. On a first installation the charge limit is off.
installerAccess: Only local administrator accounts can change charging settings. The service keeps running after the app closes and starts after a reboot.
installerOpen: Open Finder → Applications → BatteryBridge. Terminal commands are not needed. Choose a stop percentage and apply the limit.
installerFinish: Use “Uninstall BatteryBridge” in the app to remove the app and service and restore normal charging. Moving the app to Trash alone leaves the service installed.
installerUnsigned: This package is unsigned and not notarized. If macOS blocks it, review its origin and use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway only if you trust this release. Do not disable Gatekeeper.
limitExceeded: Charging continues above the saved limit. The limit is not being enforced. Check the power source and device compatibility.
sleepNotice: On this Mac, the service controls charging while awake. Firmware may reset the charging gate during sleep; a closed-lid limit cannot be guaranteed.
uninstallConfirm: Remove the app, background service and saved charging settings? Normal charging will be restored first. macOS will request an administrator password. If restoration fails, removal stops.
reasonIntelBclm: Intel SMC BCLM: firmware charge limit from 50% to 100%. Device write compatibility is experimental.
temporaryHelp: Saved settings stay unchanged. Cancel restores the saved policy.
policyPaused: Control paused. The charge limit, charging gates, MagSafe light and sleep overrides are released until the saved settings are restored or the service restarts. Saved settings are kept.
operationBusy: Another operation is still running. Wait for it to finish, then repeat this action.
adapterHelp: The adapter is restored at 20% or on cancellation, sleep or power loss.
calibrationHelp: 100% → 10% → 100%, then one hour at full charge. Requires AC; may take up to 24 hours. Heat protection stays active. Sleep, power loss or service restart cancels the cycle. This does not repair battery wear.
phaseResting: Holding full charge for one hour
heatHelp: Resumes 2°C below the limit. A missing sensor stops charging. Sensor checks occur every 30 seconds while awake.
heatPaused: Charging paused until the battery cools down.
temperatureMissing: Battery sensor unavailable. Charging remains stopped.
automaticDischarge: Discharge automatically above the saved limit (minimum 20%)
preventSleep: Prevent idle sleep during charging or discharging
preventSleepHelp: Does not prevent lid-close or manual sleep. No global power settings are changed.
rawPercentHelp: Uses reported capacity ratio when available; control always uses the system percentage.
powerHelp: Positive power flows into the battery; negative power flows out. Adapter wattage and wall consumption are not measured.
historyHelp: Charge trend: 0–100%, oldest to newest. Up to 240 readings during this app session; not saved.
automationHelp: Copy a command below. On macOS, paste it into the Shortcuts “Run Shell Script” action. Requires the installed service. Commands affect the saved machine-wide policy.
scheduleHelp: Local time on this computer. Missed tasks run once on wake/start. Tasks at the same time run in listed order. Saving replaces the list; maximum 16.
invalidScheduleDate: Enter a valid future local date and time. Times inside a daylight-saving gap cannot be selected.
autostartHelp: Start BatteryBridge in the tray when you sign in. The charging service runs independently.
autostartUnsupported: Autostart is unavailable for this build or system.
autostartApproval: Allow BatteryBridge in System Settings → General → Login Items to complete setup.
autostartWindow: The system currently starts the app with its window. Turn this option off and on to switch to the tray.
